name: worktodo
title: Worktodo
description: A local-first personal task manager for Raycast.
author: jsn

scripts.build: pnpm run build:raycast && pnpm run build:mcp
scripts.lint: CI=false ray lint && eslint mcp tests
scripts.verify: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "throw new Error('Use pnpm run publish for the Raycast Store')"

commands.name: quick-add
commands.title: Quick add
commands.description: Create a task with optional details

commands.name: backup-restore
commands.title: Backup & restore
commands.description: Export and restore Worktodo JSON backups

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Worktodo menu bar
commands.description: View and complete tasks due this week from the menu bar
